slug: 2025-11-27 Benin Cuts Digital Budget by 6.32% Despite Expanding Tech Ambitions

facts.fact: The Minister of Digital and Digitalisation presented to the National Assembly on 25 November 2025 a 2026 digital budget of CFA27.2 billion: CFA9.7bn operating and CFA17.4bn capital, across three programmes (Piloting and Support CFA2.1bn, Digital Programme CFA12.3bn, Media Programme CFA12.6bn).
facts.system: Ministry of Digital and Digitalisation budget 2026

facts.fact: The 2026 digital budget of CFA27.2bn is 6.32% lower than the CFA29.034bn approved for 2025, attributed mainly to a 12.22% fall in external financing.
facts.system: Ministry of Digital and Digitalisation budget 2026 (against 2025)

note: The budget is part funded by external financing, not wholly; the document does not say the rest is domestic by name but the ministry budget counts.
